mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: The flown-segment exception overrides ordinary cancellation eligibility.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Both original states and four expansion states produced repeated focal violations; experience lacks a comparably dense compliant precedence contrast.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Cancel a partially flown reservation under an otherwise positive cancellation ground.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Transfer without cancelling in the excluded state; ordinary eligible unflown cancellation provides a different-state control.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Segment flown status, cancellation reason, cabin, creation time, insurance.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Transfer need not complete a literal cancellation goal; changing Success to count policy-dependent refusal would entangle axes.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Transfer need not complete a literal cancellation goal; changing Success to count policy-dependent refusal would entangle axes.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: Insurance-based cancellation eligibility depends on whether the actual cancellation reason is covered.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Active states were 9/9 robust while inactive states were 0/6 correct, an A×X/B×X contrast that identifies the state-conditioned boundary.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Cancel for an uncovered reason based only on insurance possession.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Decline/transfer when no other cancellation ground exists; cancel for a covered reason in the contrasting state.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Actual reason, insurance, creation time, cabin, segment status, alternative grounds.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Covered/uncovered reason controls are different states. A fixed-state legal cancellation alternative has not been established.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Covered/uncovered reason controls are different states. A fixed-state legal cancellation alternative has not been established.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: A flight modification must preserve the reservation itinerary endpoint and trip-type scope.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Original and expansion states produced repeated focal violations; later trip-type manifestation was stable, leaving positive contrast less complete.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Modify an existing reservation to a different endpoint.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Preserve endpoint or use a separately legal alternative; later scope controls are thinner.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Actual old/new endpoints, trip type, cabin, seats, payment and cancellation eligibility if replacing.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Independent replacement can alter fare, refund, reservation count and user goal; cannot equate this endpoint anchor with LGV004.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Independent replacement can alter fare, refund, reservation count and user goal; cannot equate this endpoint anchor with LGV004.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: A single reservation permits at most five passengers; a larger party remains legal when partitioned across reservations.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Phase16D focal G violations 6/9; RECURRENT_HEADROOM. Exact-payload duplicate tasks are replication evidence, not independent states.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Book all six passengers in one reservation.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Five passengers in one reservation is legal; six split 5+1 is a structural legal witness.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Passenger list, count per booking, seat inventory, same sixth passenger and payment.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Split changes booking count and potentially certificate use. Four slots are needed for a disjoint split plus two C bookings; native maximum is three.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Split changes booking count and potentially certificate use. Four slots are needed for a disjoint split plus two C bookings; native maximum is three.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: Free checked-baggage and charging legality depends on membership and cabin; regular Economy has one free bag while regular Basic requires payment.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Phase16D focal G violations 6/12; RECURRENT_HEADROOM. Exact-payload duplicate tasks are replication evidence, not independent states.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Charge one nonfree bag to a Regular Economy passenger entitled to one free bag.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Regular Economy nonfree=0; Regular Basic nonfree=1 paid bag is the observed legal control.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Membership, cabin, total/nonfree bags, fare, payment, local budget.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Use empirical overcharge identity, not hypothetical free Basic baggage. 028 has $250 slack; 030 $120 budget makes the $50 overcharge a G-induced goal failure.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Use empirical overcharge identity, not hypothetical free Basic baggage. 028 has $250 slack; 030 $120 budget makes the $50 overcharge a G-induced goal failure.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: Direct flight change permission depends on current cabin state: Economy permits it; Basic does not, but a permitted state transition can enable it.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Phase16D focal G violations 6/6; RECURRENT_HEADROOM. Exact-payload duplicate tasks are replication evidence, not independent states.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Directly retime TOVYFC while current cabin remains Basic.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Cabin-only Basic→Economy, retime in Economy, restore Basic; historical native witness, not a Phase16D legal rollout.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Current cabin before each write, unchanged passengers/route, date and final cabin, card charges.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Temporary cabin change has positive charge $112 and net $30; a net-only budget audit is insufficient.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Temporary cabin change has positive charge $112 and net $30; a net-only budget audit is insufficient.

mechanisms.critical_governance_truth: An existing one-way reservation may be modified within one-way scope but not extended with a return; return travel may be booked independently.
mechanisms.why_empirical_focal_G_headroom: Phase16D focal G violations 6/6; RECURRENT_HEADROOM. Exact-payload duplicate tasks are replication evidence, not independent states.
mechanisms.observed_violating_path_pattern: Append HAT163 return to existing one-way 4WSQIE.
mechanisms.legal_path_pattern_and_evidence_type: Keep outbound and book the identical return independently; historical native witness, not a Phase16D legal rollout.
mechanisms.required_observable_state: Original trip type, actual old/new flight legs, target return, same user/card, free booking IDs.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Stored trip_type can remain one_way after illegal append; use actual legs. Legal path uses one additional booking slot.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Stored trip_type can remain one_way after illegal append; use actual legs. Legal path uses one additional booking slot.

historical_contract_caveat: Phase16C recoverability roles describe constructed contrast paths. Phase16D all six Basic and all six one-way rollouts violated; legal-path empirical recurrence is not claimed. Phase16E duplicate correction takes precedence over historical task-count wording.
